Several days of attempts (each jar takes about 10–80 attempts)

The pharaoh {creature:Horestis} sleeps in his tomb near Ankrahmun, sealed by five {item:Ornate Canopic Jar|Ornate Canopic Jars}. When the players on the server break all five jars, Horestis wakes up and can be fought. The reward of this world change is access to the {creature:Sandstone Scorpion} as a mount.
Ramp to the Horestis Tomb, outside Ankrahmun
Reward of this world change: depends on Horestis being woken on your server.
